text.en:
1. This Ordinance may be cited as the Government
Loans (Notice of Trusts) Ordinance, 1947, and shall
be deemed to have come into force on the 1st day of
July, 1941.

2. In this Ordinance, unless the subject or context
otherwise requires—

"the Bank'' means the Bank servicing or managing
any Government loan;

‘Government loan'' means any loan at any time
raised, or which may hereafter be raised, by the
Government of the Union, or any loan raised before
the 1st day of April, 1946, by the Government of any
territory, now comprised in the Union, in accordance
with the provisions of any written law for the time
being in force, and which is serviced or managed by
a Bank on behalf of the Government of the Union;

‘stock'? means any stock or debenture stock issued
in accordance with the terms of any Government
loan;

‘"Union'' means the Malayan Union.

3. No notice of any trust, expressed, implied or

constructive, shall be entered on any register of stock
or be receivable by the Bank in respect of any stock.
